column2: Iincwadi ze-Courier-agency + idesika yokubhukisha. Isimahla ngaphandle kweintanethi.
Isikhundla sanamhlanje. Ukubhukisha = iipasile ngaphakathi. Hlawula = amatyala ophethe & neendleko. Amaqela = abathumeli nabathwali.
Iivawutsha zeendleko kunye namatyala enkampani (imali ephumayo). I-akhawunti ihlala kwileja yeqela.
I-id yeqela yodwa (amagama angaphinda). Iindima: Umthumeli (AR), Umthwali (AP), okanye zombini kweso sazisi. Iileja zihlala zodwa; iingxelo zibonisa umnatha.

Umthumeli + umthumeli (akukho nto KULUNGILEYO) → indawo ekuyiwa kuyo → ubunzima → khetha ireyithi → Iakhawunti/Imali → hlawula. I-AWB iprinta kwirisithi. Ukubhukisha okulandelayo kucoca idesika. Isiqalo esijikwe ngokulingana ne-Fakelwe — hlela kuphela ukurhangqa ityala.
Idesika ayinanto — umthumeli/umthumeli ngokuzikhethela, seta indawo oya kuyo & nobunzima, cofa u-ADD kwireyithi, emva koko uhlawule.
Guqula i-PIN yokuvula yomntu ongenileyo kwesi sixhobo.
Nguwe kuphela onokutshintsha i-PIN yakho yokuvula (kunye negama lokungena elikhethiweyo). Buza uMnini-ndawo ukuba ufuna izikrini ezahlukeneyo okanye amalungelo.
Landela ulwimi lwesi sixhobo, okanye uzikhethele.
Vula iseva ekhoyo, okanye wenze entsha yeshishini elinye.

Iseva igcina iincwadi apha. Iklayenti idityaniswa neSeva.
Vula indawo enye ngexesha — ukuskrola okuncinci, ukhetho olucacileyo.
Ixesha imiyalezo yesimo ihlala esikrini sakho (olu ngeno).

Iilogi zihlala kwesi sixhobo. Iimfihlo (i-PIN, amagama okugqitha) azigcinwa. Ukwabelana ngephakheji ngaphandle kwesixhobo kufuna imvume yakho ecacileyo ngexesha ngalinye — azithengiswa okanye zinikwe abanye.

Uvavanyo lwalapha lulungile ku-{path} — khetha apho ugcina ikopi
Imvume yiphakheji enye, emva koko iphelelwa. Ixeshana — isetyenziselwa ukulungisa okanye ukuphucula imveliso kuphela. Ayabiwa nabanye. Isebenza kuLinux, Windows, macOS, nakwi-Android.
Iphakheji yokwabelana ilungile ku-{path} — khetha apho ugcina, emva koko uyithumele kuphela kuncedo lukaKumkaj

Isitampu sokuzikhethela kunye ne-QR yentlawulo ecaleni kwelogo yakho kwiirisithi zokubhukisha kunye namatyala exesha.

Fumana abashicileli bokwenyani, emva koko ukhethe iRisithi okanye ileyibhile ye-AWB. Umsebenzi ngamnye unobubanzi bawo, umfanekiso okanye imbonakalo yomhlaba, kunye nendlela ii-bytes ezithunyelwa ngayo. Ileyibhile iprinta ibhakhowudi. Indawo engenanto = musa ukuprinta.
Akukho mshicileli walo msebenzi - yongeza enye phantsi kwale ndawo
Iiprinta zisetwa kwisixhobo sevenkile (Iseva). Oku kude kuthumele imisebenzi apho - Fumana / yongeza / yabela ukuhlala kwiSeva. Iphepha lovavanyo liya kumncedisi.
Ukukhangela abashicileli kwesi sixhobo kunye ne-Wi-Fi...
Cinezela Fumana abashicileli bemigca abamkela imisebenzi kunye nenethiwekhi yerisithi abashicileli kule Wi-Fi (engasuswanga okanye ngaphandle kweintanethi).
Akukho bashicileli bafunyenweyo — chwetheza igama lomshicileli wenkqubo, okanye idilesi yenethiwekhi (umz. 192.168.1.50).
Akukho gcino lwasemva iintsuku ezingama-{n} — gcina i-app ivuliwe kwesi sixhobo ukuze ikwazi ukugcina.
Ziyi-{mb} MB kuphela eziseleyo kwesi sixhobo — ugcino lwasemva luya kusilela ngokukhawuleza. Vula indawo.

Ukhetho. Ukuba le PIN ichwethezwe ekuvuleni endaweni yeyakho, onke amangeno eencwadi ayacinywa (ubhukisho, iileja, imbali) kwaye idesika ivula njengoMnikazi ojongeka njengesiqhelo — iireyithi, amaqela, iindawo, abasebenzi kunye nesetingi zihlala. I-schema kunye noqwalaselo alucinywanga. Sebenzisa kuphela xa unyanzelekile ukuba uvule. Shiya kungenanto kwaye ugcine ukuze ucime. Ayisoze yafana ne-PIN yakhe nabani na.
Hlawula okukhethiweyo (gcina ityala / thatha imali yangaphambili)

Kwesi sixhobo (Iseva): Ezinye izixhobo → Vumela iipelisi ezongezelelweyo. Qaphela ikhowudi yokumatanisa kunye nedilesi ye-Wi-Fi. Cofa Vumela ezinye izixhobo ukuba ziqhagamshelane xa zivela. Kwikhompyuter, cofa Qala ngale khompyutha. Kwisixhobo esinye nesinye: faka i-app, khetha Imo yoMthengi, Fumana iseva yevenkile (okanye uchwetheze idilesi), faka ikhowudi yokubhanqa, Ibhangqa ngoku. Iiodolo zilinda kwisixhobo ukuba iWi-Fi iyawa kwaye ihambe xa iSeva iphendula kwakhona.
Ukudibanisa ibhanki (phawula ngokuchasene nengxelo yebhanki yakho)

Khetha intengiso ukuze ulungise, urhoxise ngokupheleleyo, okanye ubuyise. Ukulungisa kugcina imbali epheleleyo. Isixa esijikeleziweyo siqala silingana nokuFakweyo — hlela kuphela ukuze ujikeleze. Ukurhoxisa ngokupheleleyo nokubuyisa kunokufuna i-PIN yoMnini okanye yoMphathi (ichwethezwe ngasentla; ibhalwe negama lakho).

Ukuthumela ngaphandle kubhala umfanekiso okhawulezayo wosuku kwifolda yogcino kwaye uyikhuphele kwibhodi eqhotyoshwayo. Ukungenisa olunye usuku lokuthengisa, gcina ifayile yayo njenge import_branch_snapshot.json kuloo folda, emva koko ucofe ukungenisa.
Kuboniswa kwizikrini ngaphakathi kwi-app. Igama le-app efakelweyo nesiqondiso kwesi sixhobo kuhlala njengokubhalwa kweqonga.

Entsha = ikhathalogu engenanto (yongeza izinto kamva). Incwadi = chwetheza isitokhwe sokuvula kwaye ngubani onetyala kuwe ngezantsi.
Entsha ikhethiwe — ikhathalogu ihlala ingenanto. Cofa Igqityiwe xa ulungile.
Kamva: uSeto → faka ipakethe yelizwe lakho kwiileyibhile zerhafu nentlawulo.

Iipasile zilinganiswa njani kwidesika yokubhukisha. Chwetheza imilinganiselo kunye nobunzima kwiiyunithi ozisebenzisayo - umgangatho (cm, m, in, ft · kg, g, lb, oz) okanye iyunithi yakho edityaniswe kwi-cm / kg ngaphezulu (ngokuthe ngqo okanye ngezinye iiyunithi). Iincwadi zihlala zirekhoda kg. Shiya intsimi ingenanto ukuze uyigcine.
Chwetheza ukuba yimalini kwinto nganye (imali / i-UPI / ikhadi / ikhredithi). Kufuneka udibanise kwityala. Ityala lifuna umthengi ongentla.
Ikhathalogu, intengiso, ikhredithi, iqela, i-backup - kunye nesitokhwe kunye neetill ezongezelelweyo xa kufuneka.
Ungeno olukhethwayo (igama + igama lokugqitha). Umnini umisa kanye; umsebenzisi kuphela onokutshintsha igama lokugqitha kamva.
Okanye vula ngegama lokungena + igama lokugqitha
Umcangci: thengisa. Umphathi: thengisa + izinto + rhoxisa ngokupheleleyo/lungisa.
Le app yiMoklanjo kuphela - iincwadi + nedesika yokubhukisha. Obunye ubuso borhwebo buthunyelwa njengeemveliso ezahlukeneyo kamva.
Buyisela: khetha ugcino lwasemva. Iincwadi zivuleka njengoko zazinjalo ngelo xesha; iincwadi ezinjalo ngoku zigcinwa kuqala, ngoko oku kunokubuyiselwa.

Umnini kuphela-ukhetho olufanayo nolokukhupha iWindows. Iirekhodi zeshishini zicoca imbali yorhwebo kodwa zigcina amaxabiso kunye nokuseta (njenge-PIN yokuvula ngokungxamisekileyo). Ukuseta ivenkile kususa uvimba weencwadi. Izikhethwa zesikrini zicima ifestile/ulwimi. Qinisekisa nge-PIN yoMnini. I-PIN yokuvula likaxakeka kwiQela yahlukile (i-covert yosula ekuvuleni).
Faka i-PIN yoMnini ukuze ucime idatha yalapha.
Useto lwevenkile lucinyiwe — khetha iSeva okanye iKlayenti ukuze uqhubeke.
Chwetheza igama lento (inxalenye yanele), inani, emva koko ulungise. Izinto ezingekabalwa zifuna Qala ukulandelela kanye.

Ukuqeshwa: khetha umsebenzi (I-Cashier / uMphathi), igama + ukuqala i-PIN, emva koko Yongeza. Kuphela ukuba lo mntu uyahluka: vula izikrini kunye namalungelo angezantsi, emva koko Gcina ukuseta umsebenzi. Wonke umntu utshintsha i-PIN yakhe ezantsi — Umnini akanakutshintsha eyomnye umntu.

Iikhowudi zeelayibhile zezinto (kg, isiqwenga, ingxowa). Iyunithi nganye kufuneka idityaniswe — ngokuthe ngqo okanye ngezinye iiyunithi — nesiseko (kg · cm · ml · pc), umz. 1 crate = 2 box no 1 box = 20 cm. Uguqulo: 1 from = factor to. Iimali azizizo iiyunithi.
